load_language_sequence_from_file: load a LanguageSequence from a file containing SceneScript entity definitions
convert_sequence_to_language: convert a torch tensor sequence of tokens into a LanguageSequence of entities
normalize_and_discretize_entities: normalize and discretize LanguageSequence entity parameters into bins
sort_language_entities: sort LanguageSequence entities by lexicographic or random ordering
generate_language_string: generate a SceneScript language string from a LanguageSequence of entities
